risk.coverage_conclusion: The two risk Oracle failures (t_large_3, empty_far_3) are IllegalArgumentException: timestamp before epoch — the same class of failure that also breaks Full and other safe factors on overlapping queries. They are NOT evidence of CoverageCheck miss / false-negative leakage. This workload therefore does not expose CoverageCheck necessity; do not rewrite as 'CoverageCheck unimportant'.
